brief: Ten cartoons at the bar for Rick. Money in kitchen words, a different bill every time, Abby in four.

panels.caption: My kids don't want the house, Drew, they want the three-percent mortgage.
panels.action: Barclay raises his old fashioned an inch off the marble, the cherry rolling against the cube. Drew's martini rests on its coaster, his feathered hands folded in front of it, his head turned to Barclay.
